premises.text: SMBs are surrounded by energy data but rarely use it, so they struggle to make good energy choices
premises.evidence_span: Businesses are surrounded by energy data, but few of them use it

premises.text: Energy bills contain many unused information fields beyond the total cost line
premises.evidence_span: his energy bill actually contains over 30 unique pieces of information

premises.text: One-off consultant reports fade; costs recur without ongoing organized energy data management
premises.evidence_span: the report sits on a shelf, and then 12 months later, his energy costs have gone up

premises.text: Uploading an energy bill is enough for the system to extract, organize, visualize, and analyze energy data
premises.evidence_span: All they need is an energy bill

premises.text: Dashboard surfaces multi-year cost outlook, cost/consumption/carbon views, weather effects, and automated insights
premises.evidence_span: We automatically create insights that will warn Sean when this is happening

premises.text: External benchmarks and supplier price comparisons identify savings opportunities
premises.evidence_span: We combine Sean's data with external data sources to show him how he's performing against the best in class

premises.text: Free bill upload with paid ongoing analysis under about one pound per day per site, plus API for utilities/professionals
premises.evidence_span: we charge a fee of less than one pound per day per site

value.text: Help SMBs cut energy costs and environmental impact by understanding and acting on their energy data
value.evidence_span: helping them reduce their costs by thousands and reduce their environmental impacts

causal_links.evidence_span: make better energy decisions by organizing and analyzing their energy data
discover the power of your energy data
for free if they have an energy bill

notes: Singleton D3: pricing/API is separately revisable commercial module. Smart-meter/legislation future treated as market context not premises. Soft count 7.
